### About Me {.about-me-heading}
I am a MSc candidate at the University of Toronto studying neuroimaging and computational neuroscience. 

I am interested in neuroscience, especially with neurological disorders and bridging the gap between clinical and computational sides of health research. 

### Education
* MSc, Institute of Medical Science | University of Toronto | 2026-2028
* HBSc, Human Biology, Immunology | University of Toronto | 2022-2026

### Projects
I am currently working under Dr. Nicholas Neufeld at the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health (CAMH), observing functional trajectory, physical outcomes, and neuroimaging biomarkers in schizophrenia patients over a 5-year period.

For more information about past projects, please check out the Research or CV tab to learn more about them!
